title: Kidney Testing Method Allegedly Underestimated Risk of Black Patients
summary: Decades-long use of the estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) method to test kidney function which considers race has been criticized by physicians and medical students for its racist history and inaccuracy against Black patients.
